units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 4. On its own initiative or in response to a request provided for in paragraph 5 of this Article, the contracting authority may amend the procurement notice. The amendments shall be prepared using the unified information system, signed with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on behalf of the contracting authority and posted in the unified information system no later than one working day before the deadline for submitting procurement applications. The name of the procurement subject matter may not be changed and the amount of application security may not be increased. The application period must be extended so that, from the day following the posting of the amendments to the application deadline, it is:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 1) for electronic tenders, at least ten days;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 2) for electronic auctions, at least seven days;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 3) for electronic auctions where the initial (maximum) contract price does not exceed three hundred million roubles or the initial (maximum) contract price for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility does not exceed two billion roubles, at least three days;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 4) for electronic requests for quotations, at least three days.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.text: 5. Any procurement participant registered in the unified information system may, through the electronic platform, send the contracting authority no more than three requests for clarification of the procurement notice in an electronic tender or electronic auction, no later than three days before the deadline for submitting procurement applications. The electronic platform operator shall forward the request to the contracting authority through the platform no later than one hour after receiving it. No later than two days from the day following receipt of a request for clarification of the procurement notice, the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare a clarification, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system, indicating the subject of the request but not the participant who submitted it. Such clarifications must not alter the substance of the procurement notice.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.label: Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1. To participate in a competitive method, an application to participate in procurement must contain the following, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) information and documents concerning the procurement participant:
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) the full and abbreviated name (if any) of the legal entity, including a foreign legal entity (if the participant is a legal entity), of the accredited branch or representative office of a foreign legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the foreign legal entity), and the name of a separate subdivision of a legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the participant); the surname, first name and patronymic (if any) (if the participant is an individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) the surname, first name, patronymic (if any), taxpayer identification number (if any) and position of the person entitled to act without a power of attorney on behalf of the legal entity, or acting as head of the legal entity or accredited branch or representative office of a foreign legal entity, or performing the functions of the sole executive body of the legal entity;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: в) the taxpayer identification number (if any) of members of the collegial executive body, the person performing the functions of the sole executive body, the manager (if any), the management organization (if any), participants (members) of a corporate legal entity holding more than twenty-five per cent of its shares (participatory interests or units), and founders of a unitary legal entity, or the equivalent of those persons’ taxpayer identification numbers under the law of the relevant foreign State;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: г) the address of the legal entity, including a foreign legal entity, within its place of location (if the participant is a legal entity), the address (location) of the accredited branch or representative office in the Russian Federation (if it acts on behalf of a foreign legal entity), the address (location) of the separate subdivision of the legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the participant), the place of residence of the individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur (if the participant is an individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur), email address and contact telephone number;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: д) a copy of the document identifying the procurement participant under the legislation of the Russian Federation (if the participant is an individual who is not an individual entrepreneur);
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: е) the taxpayer identification number of the legal entity (if the participant is a legal entity), the accredited branch or representative office of a foreign legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the foreign legal entity), or the individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur (if the participant is an individual, including one registered as an individual entrepreneur); the equivalent of a taxpayer identification number under the law of the relevant foreign State (if the participant is a foreign person); and the tax registration reason code of the legal entity (if the participant is a legal entity), the accredited branch or representative office of a foreign legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the foreign legal entity), or the separate subdivision of a legal entity (if it acts on behalf of the participant);
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: ж) an extract from the Unified State Register of Legal Entities (if the participant is a legal entity), or an extract from the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs (if the participant is an individual entrepreneur);
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: з) a duly certified Russian translation of documents on the State registration of the legal entity or of the individual as an individual entrepreneur under the law of the relevant State (if the participant is a foreign person);
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: и) a declaration that the procurement participant is an institution or enterprise of the penal correction system (if the participant is such an institution or enterprise);
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: к) a declaration that the procurement participant is an organization of persons with disabilities specified in Article 29(2) of this Federal Law (if the participant is such an organization);
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: л) a declaration that the procurement participant is a socially oriented non-profit organization, where the preference provided for in Article 30(3) of this Federal Law is established;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: м) a decision consenting to or subsequently approving a major transaction, if such a decision is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation or the legal entity’s constituent documents, and concluding a contract for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services that are the subject matter of procurement, or depositing funds as application security or contract performance security, constitutes a major transaction for the procurement participant;
units.label: Subpoint «м» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: н) information and documents demonstrating that the participant meets the requirements of Article 31(1)(1) of this Federal Law (which may be omitted from the application if they are contained in open and publicly accessible State registers available on the Internet and the application includes the declaration, provided for in subpoint “о” of this point, of compliance with the requirements of Article 31(1)(1) of this Federal Law), and information and documents demonstrating compliance with the additional requirements established under Article 31(2) and (2.1) of this Federal Law (where applicable), unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «н» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: о) a declaration that the participant meets the requirements of Article 31(1)(3)–(5) and (7)–(11) of this Federal Law (if information and documents demonstrating compliance with Article 31(1)(1) of this Federal Law are contained in open and publicly accessible State registers available on the Internet, the declaration may also state compliance with Article 31(1)(1) of this Federal Law and give the address of the website or web page on the Internet where those information and documents are posted);
units.label: Subpoint «о» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: п) details of the procurement participant’s account to which, under the legislation of the Russian Federation, payment is to be transferred for goods delivered, works performed (their results), services provided and individual stages of contract performance, except where that legislation requires the account to be opened after the contract is concluded;
units.label: Subpoint «п» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: р) where an electronic tender is held and the criterion provided for in Article 32(1)(4) of this Federal Law is established, the procurement application may contain information and documents demonstrating the participant’s qualifications. Absence of such information and documents is not grounds for finding that the application fails to comply with this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «р» Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) the procurement participant’s offer concerning the procurement subject matter:
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) subject to paragraph 2 of this Article, the characteristics of the goods offered by the participant that meet the indicators established in the description of the procurement subject matter under Article 33(2) of this Federal Law, and the trademark (if the goods have one);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) the name of the country of origin of the goods according to the All-Russian classification used to identify countries of the world, subject to paragraph 2 of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: в) documents demonstrating that the goods, works or services meet requirements established under the legislation of the Russian Federation (where that legislation establishes requirements for them and the procurement notice or procurement documentation, where provided for by this Federal Law, requires those documents). The contracting authority may not require those documents if, under the legislation of the Russian Federation, they are to be delivered together with the goods;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: г) subject to paragraph 2 of this Article, an offer addressing the criteria provided for in Article 32(1)(2) and/or (3) of this Federal Law (where tenders are held and such criteria are established). Absence of such an offer is not grounds for rejecting a procurement application;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: д) other information and documents, including a sketch, drawing, technical drawing, photograph or other image of the goods offered by the procurement participant. Absence of such information and documents is not grounds for rejecting a procurement application;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) the participant’s offer of the contract price (except in the case provided for in point 4 of this paragraph);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4) the participant’s offer of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 5) information and documents determined under Article 14(2)(2) of this Federal Law (where the procurement notice or procurement documentation, if provided for by this Federal Law, establishes a prohibition, restriction or preference provided for by that Article). If such information and documents are absent from the procurement application, it shall be treated as an application offering goods originating in a foreign State, works performed or services provided by foreign persons.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2. When preparing the participant’s offer concerning the procurement subject matter:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) the information on goods specified in paragraph 1(2), subpoints “а” and “б”, of this Article shall be included in the procurement application when procuring goods, including goods supplied to the contracting authority in the course of performing the procured works or providing the procured services. The information specified in paragraph 1(2)(а) of this Article may be omitted if the contracting authority specifies a trademark in the description of the procurement subject matter and the participant offers goods bearing that trademark, including goods supplied in the course of performing the procured works or providing the procured services;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) the information specified in paragraph 1(2), subpoints “а” and “г”, of this Article shall not be included in the procurement application where the contracting authority includes design documentation, standard design documentation or an estimate for major repairs of a capital construction facility in the description of the procurement subject matter under Article 33(1)(8) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3. A procurement participant may not be required to provide information or documents other than those specified in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4. A procurement participant may submit only one application, at any time from the posting of the procurement notice in the unified information system (when open competitive methods of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection are used), or receipt of the invitation and procurement documentation (when closed competitive methods of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection are used), until the application deadline established under this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 5. Submitting a procurement application signifies the applicant’s agreement to supply the goods, perform the works or provide the services on the terms specified in the procurement notice and procurement documentation (where provided for by this Federal Law), and in accordance with that participant’s procurement application.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 6. In electronic procedures and closed electronic procedures:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) only a procurement participant registered in the unified information system and accredited on the electronic platform or specialized electronic platform may submit an application, by sending it in accordance with this Federal Law to the operator of the electronic platform or specialized electronic platform;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) the participant shall not include the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(1), subpoints “а”–“л”, of this Article in its application. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall send that information and those documents to the contracting authority, current as at the date and time of sending, through information exchange with the unified information system;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) in electronic procedures, the participant shall not include in its application the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(1)(н) of this Article demonstrating compliance with the additional requirements established under Article 31(2) or (2.1) of this Federal Law (where applicable). In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the electronic platform operator shall send that information and those documents to the contracting authority from the register of participants accredited on the electronic platform, current as at the date and time of sending;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4) in closed electronic procedures, the participant shall not include in its application the information and documents specified in paragraph 1(1)(н) of this Article. In the cases provided for by this Federal Law, the specialized electronic platform operator shall send that information and those documents to the contracting authority from the register of participants accredited on the specialized electronic platform, current as at the date and time of sending;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 5) no later than one hour after receiving a procurement application, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall return it to the applicant in the following cases:
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) the application is submitted in violation of Article 5(1) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) one participant submits two or more procurement applications without withdrawing its previously submitted applications. In that case, all its procurement applications shall be returned;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: в) the application is submitted after the deadline for submitting procurement applications;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: г) the participant submits, in accordance with this Federal Law, an application containing an offer of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services that exceeds, respectively, the initial (maximum) contract price or the initial total of unit prices, or is equal to zero;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: д) a foreign State is indicated as the country of origin of the goods under paragraph 1(2)(б) of this Article where the procurement notice prohibits procurement of goods originating in a foreign State under Article 14(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: е) the electronic platform operator receives from the bank the information specified in Article 44(5)(3)(г) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: ж) the registration entry number is absent from the register of independent guarantees posted in the unified information system; the identification code of the procurement for which the independent guarantee was issued as application security does not match the code in the procurement notice or invitation; or the independent guarantee amount is less than the application security required by the contracting authority under this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: з) the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers) provided for by this Federal Law contains information on the procurement participant, including its collegial executive body members or the person performing the functions of the sole executive body of a participant that is a legal entity, provided that the requirement under Article 31(1.1) of this Federal Law has been established;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: и) the register of participants accredited on the electronic platform lacks the participant’s information and documents included in the list established by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 31(3) of this Federal Law (where the procurement notice establishes additional requirements for participants under Article 31(2) or (2.1) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: к) the application is submitted by a participant that is neither a small enterprise nor a socially oriented non-profit organization where the procurement notice establishes the preference provided for in Article 30(3) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: л) the application is submitted by a foreign participant where the procurement notice prohibits procurement of works performed or services provided by foreign persons under Article 14(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: м) the procurement application is submitted by a participant that has not been sent an invitation or provided with procurement documentation (in closed electronic procedures);
units.label: Subpoint «м» Point 5 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 6) when returning an application under point 5 of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall simultaneously notify the applicant of its return and the grounds for it. Applications may not be returned on grounds other than those specified in point 5 of this paragraph;
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 7) after an application is returned on the grounds specified in point 5 of this paragraph, the participant may submit a new application in accordance with this Article;
units.label: Point 7 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 8) no later than one hour after receiving an application that is not subject to return under point 5 of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator must assign it an identification number and notify the participant of receipt, indicating that number;
units.label: Point 8 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 9) no later than one hour after the application deadline, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority, in accordance with this Federal Law, the applications not returned on the grounds specified in point 5 of this paragraph, together with the dates and times of their submission.
units.label: Point 9 Part 6 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 7. In a closed tender or closed auction, a procurement application shall be submitted in writing in a sealed envelope, in the form, manner and place specified in the procurement documentation. Copies of documents included in the application shall be certified by the participant. All sheets of the application and of each volume must be bound and numbered. The application and each volume must contain an inventory of the documents included, bear the participant’s seal (if any) (for a legal entity), and be signed by a person authorized to act on its behalf. Compliance with those requirements signifies that the information and documents in the application and its volumes are submitted on behalf of the participant and that it is responsible for their authenticity and accuracy. The procurement identification code stated in the invitation shall be indicated on the envelope. No other requirements for the form of the application may be imposed. However, improper compliance with the requirement to number all sheets of the application and its volumes is not grounds for finding that the application fails to comply with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 8. In a closed tender or closed auction, a participant may amend its application before the application deadline in the procedure established under Article 72(1)(1)(д) of this Federal Law. The amendment shall be registered in the procedure established by this Federal Law for registering procurement applications. The date and time of submission of the amendment shall be deemed the date and time of submission of the application. Applications may not be amended in electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 43
